title: Test forms and their exterior derivatives have bounded Euclidean covector norm
statement: For all N, k ∈ ℕ and every test form ω ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^N) (TestFormOn univ k) there are real numbers a and b such that covectorEuclideanNorm(ω(y)) ≤ a and covectorEuclideanNorm((exteriorDerivative ω)(y)) ≤ b for every y ∈ ℝ^N.
lean_statement: ∀ (N k : ℕ) (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k), (∃ a : ℝ, ∀ y, covectorEuclideanNorm ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) k) y) ≤ a) ∧ ∃ b : ℝ, ∀ y, covectorEuclideanNorm (exteriorDerivative (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) k) y) ≤ b
